summary: A fleet that answers an ask with nothing at all, which is the strongest thing a fleet can say and was the one wait nothing exempted. An offer query is a search on the shape asked for, so a marketplace that returned no machine has said it sells nothing of that shape: no amount of waiting for the fleet as it stands turns that into a machine, and the ask is waiting for capacity to be added exactly as an ask every published machine was weighed against and refused is. The patient Run arrives first and is told so, and the record states the evidence beside the reason: no machine weighed, none that could hold it. Twelve minutes later a Run of a class that starts far above it arrives, and by then waiting has promoted the first Run past that class. Everything the queue does next used to turn on a fleet that published nothing being read as a wait for capacity to come free. The ask kept the queue, so the second Run was ordered behind an ask nothing in the fleet even matches, and stayed there for the twenty four hours the patient class allows: one submission for a shape nobody sells stalled every other Run in the workspace, while the fleet went on selling exactly what that work asked for. The classification is read off the fleet's own answer now rather than off the word Mercator wrote beside it, so both Runs wait on their own account and neither is behind the other.
